sections.heading: Establish the current entitlement
paragraphs: The official URLs inspected during this research redirected to Devin. Do not copy a historic Windsurf price into a new budget. Ask the vendor which product and plan a new purchase now buys and what happens to an existing account.

sections.heading: Rehearse a reversible move
paragraphs: Export a record of your extensions, settings and repository rules before testing another editor. Keep the old environment available until build, test and review tasks can be reproduced. Migration difficulty remains a question for your installation, not a measured score here.

pros.text: The current Devin Desktop product page describes a full IDE with syntax highlighting, autocomplete and debugging tools.

cons.text: The official Windsurf editor URL redirects to a Devin Desktop page, so the current product name and new-purchase destination should be confirmed before selection.

faqs.question: What does the Windsurf editor page identify as the current desktop product?
faqs.answer: The inspected Windsurf editor URL redirects to Devin Desktop, whose page describes a full IDE. Confirm account history, entitlements and current pricing with the vendor before acting on a legacy Windsurf plan.

verdict: Pause a new purchase decision until the current product identity and account migration terms are confirmed. This entry preserves the existing Windsurf URL.
bestFor: Existing users checking continuity of their editor workflow
notFor: New buyers relying on old Windsurf prices
migration: Record your current account entitlement and editor settings. Ask the vendor to confirm what transfers; do not assume a redirect preserves a subscription.
gaps: The official editor destination identifies Devin Desktop as the current page; verify account history, plan entitlements and pricing before publication.
